notes.title: Fixed undying mode to have propper number of segments
notes.content: Undying mode was set to only 1 segment. It is now 3 as intended.

notes.title: Game progression
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Moved a few of the reward cards into progression unlocks. You'll need to unlock them now before they are offered as rewards.
[*] Updated tutorial to better describe rewards.
[*] Added more pretty to the card choice.
[*] Minor bug fixes related to pause screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor fix - tutorial
notes.content: Fixed a bug where running the tutorial would shorten a normal game to just one segment.

notes.title: Tutorial back online
notes.content: Changes to menu function had broken the tutorial mode. It is fixed.

notes.title: Reward Choices Live
notes.content:
Now when earning a combo reward, the game will pause and you will get 3 choices. Some choices have a negative (game gets faster/harder), so pick wisely!

On first run, game will detect OS language.
